# Sara Carle Photography

> A print room in Bradford, West Yorkshire, England that prints, frames and binds customers' own photographs and posts them to UK addresses.
> It does not take photographs: no sessions, no shoots, no restoration, no wedding albums, no posting outside the UK.

## Price list (GBP)
- Lustre print, 8 × 10 in: £9 (Giclée on 260 gsm lustre paper)
- Matte print, A3: £18 (Giclée on 230 gsm matte paper, 297 × 420 mm)
- Framed print, A4 oak frame: £45 (A4 print, oak moulding, glazed, ready to hang)
- Canvas wrap, 16 × 20 in: £69 (Stretched on 38 mm pine bars, mirrored edges)
- Lay-flat photo book, 20 pages: £55 (21 × 21 cm, hard cover, opens dead flat)
- Rocket Pool summer photo book: £39 (15 × 15 cm, 16 pages, ready-made bright layout)

- [Frames, canvas and photo books](https://saracarlephotography.com/frames-and-canvas.html): oak, black and white mouldings, canvas wraps, lay-flat books, the Rocket Pool summer photo book
- [Print size calculator](https://saracarlephotography.com/print-size-calculator.html): inches = pixels / ppi; 300 ppi in the hand, 200 on a shelf, 150 across a room
- [Order prints](https://saracarlephotography.com/order-prints.html): order form with a running total; confirmed by e-mail with a secure payment link
- [About the print room](https://saracarlephotography.com/about-the-print-room.html)
- [Postage and packaging](https://saracarlephotography.com/postage-and-packaging.html): Original Delivery, tracked, flat in rigid board
